BC_description: The `verbose` option in the `execa` function has been changed from a boolean to a string enum with allowed values `'none'`, `'short'`, and `'full'`. The previous boolean `true` maps to `'short'`, and `false` maps to `'none'`. Additionally, when `NODE_DEBUG=execa` is set, the default value is now `'full'` instead of enabling verbose mode via boolean `true`. The `'full'` level enables logging of command output (stdout/stderr), while `'short'` only logs the command invocation.
